content: De7o shuchchinne geeshsha dere
Hessa gish iitateth wursi, baleththo wursi, qoodheppe qommon hano, qanateteth aykko qommo zigirs intefe diggite.
Ha7i yeletida guutha nayti maath amottizayssa mala inteka attanas, izan dicci dicci baanas geeshi gidida Ayana timirte laamotite.
Inte laamotanas bessizay Goday kiya gididayssa shaakki erkkokko!
Hessa gish gede de7o shuch gidida Yesusakko shiiqite. He shuchchay asay leqqi aggidayssa shin Xoossa achchan qas doorettidayssanne boncho waagay dizayssa.

Inte gede Goda Yesusakko shiiqanayka de7o shuchcha mala Xillo Ayana duussaso gidana mala ooseteta; hessathoka inte Yesus Kirstoosa baggara ufaysiza Ayana yarsho Xoossas shiishshanaas geeshsha Qeeseta gidandeta.
Geeshsha Maxaafan “Hekko doorettida boncho gidida keeththas maazenen uttiza shuch tani Xiyoonen wothana. Izan ammanizadey yeellatenna” giza qaalay xaafeti uttides.
Hessa gish intes ammanizaytas he shuchchay boncho shuchchikko shin hinko izan ammanontaytas qas “Shuchchan keexxiza keeththa hiillati leqqi wora yeggidays izi keeththa maazenes hu7e gidides”
Qasseka “Hekko ase dhuphiza shuchchay hayssich! Asa dhuphi kundisiza zaalla shuchchay hayssakko” gees. Isti qaala ammanonta ixida gish dhuphetetes. Kasekka isti hessas dizayta.
Inte qas dhumappe gede daro malalisiza iza poo7okko xeygida malalisiza Xoossa ooththo awajjanas doorettida yeleteth, Kawo Qeeseta, Xoossi intena baas histida inte dumma dereta.
Inte kase Xoossa dere gidekketa shin ha7i gidikko inte Xoossa dere. Inte kase intes Xoosse qadhetonta derekko shin ha7i gidikko qadhetides.
Xoossa oosanchata
Ta siiqoto! Inte hayssa alameza bolla imathenne bete as gidida gish shempora olettiza asho amotethatappe haakkana mala ta intena hadara gays.

Oone erizay “Intena isti iita ooththetes” giidi asay zigirikkokka Xoossi nuna beyanas yiza gallas Ayzaabeti inte oosoy lo7o gididayssa be7idi Xoosse galatana mala inte istara diza wode inte amaley lo7o gido.
Inte Goda Yesusa gish giidi dere ayssizaytas azazetite. Kawoy qas ubbafe bollara diza gish kawossika azazetite.
Dere ayssizaytas azazetite. Isti iita ooththizayta qaxayanassinne lo7o ooththizayta galatanas Kawoppe kiitetizayta.
Inte lo7o ooson hanko eray baynda eeyateththan haasayizayta co7u histana mala hessika Xoossa shene.
Inte Xoossas ooththiza asata mala gididi hirgay baynda de7ite attin inte inte shene mala diza duussa iitatetha kammiza miish histofte.
As ubbakka bonchite. Ammanizayta siiqite. Xoossas babbite. Kawo bonchite.
Kirstoosa waayetetha leemiso
Inteno Asas ooththi aqizayto! Intena oosissiza godatas bonchon azazetite. Inte azazettanay lo7otasinne ashketas xalala gidonta hanko iitatassarakko!
Asi galatettizay coo mela qohettishe; hessika Xoossa gish giidi dandayanna.
Inte iita ooththida gish qaxayetishe dandayikko intes aaza galatay daanee? Inte lo7o ooththidi waaye ekkishe dandayikko inte Xoossafe galata ekkandeta.
Inte xeeygetidaykka hessassa. Inte iza leemiso kaallana mala Kirstoosi inte gish waaye ekkidi intes leemiso gidides.
Izi aykko nagarakka ooththibenna. Iza duunan geney bettibenna.
Asay iza cayishin izi zaari cayibenna. Waayetishe bana tumu pirdiza Godas hadara aaththi immides attin halo kessana mandibenna.
Nuni nagarappe shaakatidi xillotethan daana mala izi barka ba ashon nu nagara masqale bolla tookkides. Inte iza madunthan paxideta.
Inte dhayida dorsata mala coo mela tuuyru tuuyrideta shin ha7i qas inte shempo heemmizayssakonne naagizayssako simmideta.
